name: Haiku small/mid-cap growth
strategy: Rate-defensive small/mid-cap growth leveraging quality SaaS infrastructure positions with strong guidance and elevated cash, reducing broad large-cap tech exposure in rising-rate environment
reassessment_note: Round 3 severely underperformed (down -7.14% vs SPY +3.26%) due to excessive QQQ exposure (22%) that failed to lead in large-cap tech downturn. The thesis had merit but execution drifted from mandate: only 5% ARKK vs Round 2's 12%, no IWM exposure vs Round 2's 14%. Rising rate environment (10-year yields at 5.2%+, 70% odds of October rate hike, $3.3B IWM outflows this week) demands more defensive positioning. Rebalancing to: (1) eliminate broad-market QQQ exposure entirely, (2) retain only high-conviction mega-caps (MSFT up 1.52%, NVDA up 0.65%) showing individual strength against broader weakness, (3) shift core to quality SaaS infrastructure with proven momentum (Snowflake beat Q2 with 35% YoY growth, Datadog raising guidance, CrowdStrike trading at premium for reason, Shopify outperforming amid e-commerce growth), (4) increase cash from 44% to 50% as rate hedge against further yield spikes, (5) restore small/mid-cap mandate focus via 6% ARKK positioning. Satisfies novelty rule with 36-44% overlap vs Round 2.

positions.thesis: Microsoft showing AI strength and Azure acceleration (43% revenue growth in FY2026 Q4). Large-cap tech bellwether; individual momentum trumps broad-market weakness. Maintaining core position despite sector headwinds based on competitive AI moat.

Nvidia announced $150B share buyback and rose 1.68% against trend on 2026-09-29. AI infrastructure demand remains robust despite rate headwinds. Capital deployment signals management confidence in secular AI growth thesis.

CrowdStrike trades at premium multiples but raised guidance (0.9%+ raise), reflecting strong security demand. Cybersecurity non-discretionary spend and cloud-native architecture insulate from rate sensitivity. Positioning in growth category of SaaS infrastructure.

Datadog raised guidance by 2%+ in Q2 2026 earnings. AI workload monitoring and deepening customer adoption position for sustained high growth despite macro headwinds. Five-year annual growth estimate 19% justifies positioning.

Snowflake beat Q2 2026 with 35% YoY revenue growth and strong guidance: $6.07B FY product revenue vs $5.84B guided in May. AI/data platform tailwind and CoCo coding agent opportunity. Strong execution amid rate volatility.

Shopify commerce platform benefits from secular e-commerce growth and enterprise adoption. Small/mid-cap growth exposure within SaaS infrastructure basket. Less rate-sensitive than pure growth names due to revenue model.

ARK Innovation ETF restores small/mid-cap growth mandate alignment lost in QQQ overweight. Captures innovation factor across fintech, cloud, and AI; diversifies away from mega-cap tech concentration. Necessary for Round 3 novelty compliance and strategy consistency.
